title: Register with the construction industry long service scheme
what: Register with the state's portable long service leave scheme and report eligible construction workers' service.

sources.title: Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 7 (note) (republication of 19/11/2025 (Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 | Acts))
sources.quote: Note An employer for a covered industry must apply for registration under s 31.

reach.condition: if it employs workers in the building and construction industry as the state scheme defines it

sources.title: Long service leave employer registration
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this registration if you intend to provide employment to workers within the building and construction, community sector, cleaning or security industries.

confidence_note: Quoted from the law's current text on 10 Nov 2026, replacing the ABLIS-first draft (methods rule 5a); the ABLIS listing stays as a reach source.

assessment.summary: Employers must register with the industry's portable long service leave scheme, report workers' service and pay a levy.

marks.reason: Workers keep their long service entitlement when they move between employers in the industry.
Registration, quarterly service returns and the levy.
